title: Contradictory statements in one Interview Session remain a Conflict

persona.name: Iris
persona.brief: Report both current-looking deadlines and do not choose between them.

mission.objective: Establish the acknowledgement deadline for amber alerts.
mission.desired_outcome: A supported deadline or an explicit unresolved conflict.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the finding before changing alert automation.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: What is the acknowledgement deadline for an amber alert?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: The alert timer needs one approved deadline.
investigation_results.relevant_context: The coordinator uses both the team briefing and the on-call rota.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The current deadline is supported, or incompatible current sources are retained as a Conflict.

turns.sourceQuestion: How quickly does an amber alert need to be acknowledged?

answer.text: The team briefing this week said within four hours.

turns.sourceQuestion: What deadline does the on-call rota use for amber alerts?

answer.text: The on-call rota I used today says two hours. Both the rota and this week's team briefing look current, and I cannot reconcile two hours with four.
